manaNeeded: {5}{G}{U}{U} your first turn, with {5}{U}{U} available each other turn
notablePrerequisites: Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.You have no basic lands in library.
description:
Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, causing you to mill your library.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat from step 2.
